description: Create a video DRAFT — nothing is rendered and no credits are charged. Director mode, the recommended way to make a video the user has opinions about: (1) write and agree the script with the user in this conversation first — narration per scene and what each scene should show; (2) call autoshort_draft_video with scenes[] (free, nothing is rendered or charged); (3) show the user the draft (scenes, estimated length, estimated credits, warnings) and apply their changes with autoshort_update_draft; (4) only after the user approves, call autoshort_render_draft — that is when credits are charged. Narration is read VERBATIM: AutoShort never rewrites it. Each scene with a `visual` gets exactly that image (plus the art style). A scene can carry image_url (the user's own picture, public https link): that scene shows it instead of a generated image, and the draft marks it imageSource "your image". Pass scenes[] for a script you agreed with the user (free; stored word for word), or a brief to have AutoShort write one draft for review (needs a positive credit balance, max 20 per hour). Returns draftId, the scenes, estimatedDurationSeconds, estimatedCredits and warnings[].

artStyle.description: Visual style; see autoshort_list_niches. Default AUTOSHORTS (cinematic photography).

brief.description: Only when there is no agreed script: what the video should be about. With scenes[] it is used as context for auto images.

language.description: BCP-47 narration language ("en", "vi", …). Omit to detect it from the narration.

scenes.description: The agreed script, scene by scene, in order.

image_url.description: Optional. Show the user's OWN image in this scene instead of a generated one (https URL, JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 10 MB). Animated WebP uses its first frame; GIF and SVG are rejected. Downloaded once, cleaned (EXIF/GPS removed) and served from AutoShort. Same limits as image_urls on autoshort_generate_chat_video.

narration.description: Exactly what the voice reads for this scene. Read verbatim — never rewritten.

seconds.description: Desired shot length. The spoken narration sets the real length; a mismatch is reported in warnings[].

visual.description: What the viewer SEES in this scene, as a shot description ("close-up of hands holding a coffee and a planner, morning light"). Becomes the image prompt as written, plus the art style. Omit to let AutoShort pick an image from the narration.

targetDuration.description: Requested length in seconds. Kept as requested — if the verbatim narration cannot fit it, warnings[] says so with a word count that would.

title.description: Headline shown over the first 1.5s and used as the video title. Defaults to the first sentence.

name: autoshort_draft_video
